sabbats.Imbolc: the first light returns; kindle a flame
sabbats.Ostara: day and night in balance; plant a seed
sabbats.Beltane: fire and blossom; let joy run wild
sabbats.Litha: the longest day; stand in your power
sabbats.Lughnasadh: the first harvest; give thanks for bread
sabbats.Mabon: the second harvest; share what you reaped
sabbats.Yule: the sun is reborn; light a candle

lunar.blue: a rare moon; make a bold wish

tarot.name: The Fool
tarot.upright: new beginnings, a leap of faith
tarot.reversed: recklessness; look before you leap

tarot.name: The Magician
tarot.upright: skill and will; you have the tools
tarot.reversed: scattered focus, tricks and half-truths

tarot.name: The High Priestess
tarot.upright: intuition; listen to the quiet voice
tarot.reversed: secrets kept, the inner voice ignored

tarot.name: The Empress
tarot.upright: abundance; tend what you are growing
tarot.reversed: a creative block; care for yourself first

tarot.name: The Emperor
tarot.upright: structure and steady authority
tarot.reversed: rigid control; loosen your grip

tarot.name: The Hierophant
tarot.upright: tradition and shared wisdom
tarot.reversed: question the rules you inherited

tarot.name: The Lovers
tarot.upright: a true choice; align heart and values
tarot.reversed: imbalance; a choice put off too long

tarot.name: The Chariot
tarot.upright: willpower; steer straight ahead
tarot.reversed: pulled in two directions at once

tarot.name: Strength
tarot.upright: quiet courage and patience
tarot.reversed: self-doubt; be gentle with yourself

tarot.name: The Hermit
tarot.upright: solitude and inner guidance
tarot.reversed: isolation; time to come back out

tarot.name: Wheel of Fortune
tarot.upright: the wheel turns; ride the change
tarot.reversed: a bad spin; it will turn again

tarot.name: Justice
tarot.upright: fairness, truth, cause and effect
tarot.reversed: an imbalance that needs owning

tarot.name: The Hanged Man
tarot.upright: pause and see it from another side
tarot.reversed: stalling; stop waiting to be saved

tarot.name: Death
tarot.upright: an ending that clears the way
tarot.reversed: clinging to what is already over

tarot.name: Temperance
tarot.upright: balance, patience, the middle way
tarot.reversed: excess; find your measure again

tarot.name: The Devil
tarot.upright: a binding habit; name the chain
tarot.reversed: breaking free, one link at a time

tarot.name: The Tower
tarot.upright: sudden upheaval; the truth breaks through
tarot.reversed: a collapse delayed, not avoided

tarot.name: The Star
tarot.upright: hope and renewal after the storm
tarot.reversed: despair, lost faith; rest and wait

tarot.name: The Moon
tarot.upright: illusion and dreams; trust your gut
tarot.reversed: the fog lifts; fears fade

tarot.name: The Sun
tarot.upright: joy, warmth, a clear success
tarot.reversed: a cloudy day; joy delayed, not denied

tarot.name: Judgement
tarot.upright: a calling; rise and answer it
tarot.reversed: self-doubt drowns out the call

tarot.name: The World
tarot.upright: completion; a cycle closes well
tarot.reversed: loose ends before the finish
